structural_law: Short interval width does not reduce the Maynard S parameter. In W4, S_May is tied to the magnitude of z=s1*s2 via Z≈S_May^2. A subinterval inside s≈X^(1/2) still has s magnitude X^(1/2), so it still forces S_May≈X^(1/2). A true S_May<=X^(3/10) selection leaves the current full-S dyadic block. Thus the remaining scale route requires a new full-S dispersion atom.
